content: Vikram Patel followed up with Ananya Nair regarding her auto policy that expired on March 8th, providing a quote for a new policy and offering reinstatement options. Ananya expressed interest in reinstating her old policy and asked for the next steps and information on potential penalties for the lapse in coverage.

action_items: Guide Ananya through the policy reinstatement process
Confirm if there are any penalties for the lapse in coverage
